title: Robert Contreras interviews Bitcoin miner Ryan Conley of BitClub Network - BitLife ClubCoin
description: 12/19/15 - BitClub member Robert Contreras interviews team leader Ryan Conley as he explains what Bitcoin is and the power of ...

asr.full_text: Hi, everybody. I'm Robert Contreras. I flew up here from California to meet with the wonderful Ryan Connally he's a big club Ninja I would call you you know everything about it. You know how to uh work it anyway have some Questions I want to ask him because I'm having I'm starting up a meetup down in, California He's got one up. It's gonna start one up here in Washington, right? Yeah, I'm looking forward to that So I just have some basic questions for people that don't maybe don't know a lot about Bitcoin. And basically the first question is what is Bitcoin? Well, Bitcoin is, it's the first I call it, the first finite money supply. And that's really important, right. there because nowadays, you know, the federal governments, they go ahead and they're able to print more money all the times. And also in the news recently Leonardo DiCaprio just invested in a company that's manufacturing diamonds basically just from diamond dust. They're able to make something like a 20 carat diamond for the cost of nothing so yes that just took place. And then, when it comes to gold and stuff, get me really interested in stuff cause we, gold can always can be found on another planet there is not a finite amount of gold at all either. So when you have something mathematically backed like bitcoin there is only going to be 21 million Bitcoins and what that means is that as bitcoin becomes more popular and more people are using it that price of Bitcoins goes up in value. That's really exciting right there. I think we're really living in a day and age where… we've got a currency war obviously going across the world taking place right now and a lot of people are hurting and it's because of the centralization of money rather than when it should be decentralized. So, that's what we're doing with Bitcoin right now. Great, great, now what is this BitClub network? I'm involved in too now. Because you do know, but you want me to answer the question. Yeah, yeah, tell me a little bit more about it. Yeah, BitClub Network is badass. It is … I compare it, I did a video the other day about how BitClub Network is kind of like Microsoft is to computer so Bitcoin Network is two computers as Microsoft is to Bitcoin they just work more efficiently when they're coupled together right there and what allows us to do is allows us to go ahead and monetize our relationships when it comes to expanding the Bitcoin community and reward you for those efforts um you can see I'm pretty hardcore into Bitcoin. I'm rocking all my Bitcoin gear, long time. I got Bitcoin tattoos down my shoulder and stuff, kind of really into it, but Bitcoin Network is it started off as a mining, just the world's largest crowdfunded Bitcoin Mine. Okay, so we've got this mine in Iceland that's mining Bitcoin on geothermal energy all the time so we're able to actually do it of productive means that actually is lucrative for the members of the network. And this pays out in bitcoin every single day to the people that are mining in Bitcoin. But I didn't know that. There was more to where we first joined but where we're taking this right now is we're moving into merchant processing of Bitcoin, that's humongous because if you think about it I mean, we're outside Starbucks right now or you just bought your first Starbucks latte with using Bitcoin but you know all these places around us they accept credit cards and debit cards and they need a special machine to do that right there and they're paying a whole bunch of Money to use those and they're paying like 3 to 5 percent on their Bitcoin, excuse me, on their processing. But what we're about to do is launch that Bitcoin merchant servicing to all these different companies out there, where it drops it down to 1% and since you turn the company onto the BitClub Network, every time someone buys something there, you're getting half of that 1%, right there. So 50% of the 1%. So, if you think about your friend owns a car dealership, as it becomes more popular there's gonna be some big Bitcoin purchases, just had a plastic surgeon come on board with us also, a friend of ours, you know, some big money going through his clinic, obviously, and so that could be your friend's coffee stand or your friend's bar tonight, but, the point of it is you've got transactions, money coming to you every single day through that right there. So, that's exciting yeah and we pay we pay Commission's on people that review introducing into the network so we've actually you saw that I made five hundred bucks today alone just love all I did was go yoga so there's a lot gonna be a lot of money you do mate and big Club network okay so you made that five hundred bucks how do you spend it I mean definitely, how does that work? Definitely. So what I do is I transfer the money out of BitClub Network into a Bitcoin wallet, whether that's from Coinbase, if that's from AirBits. And if you go to AirBits right now it's really cool because they have a directory in there which we're actually looking to do with our Bitcoin merchant services and stuff, and maybe there's going to be something that happens there, but we will you can pay with Bitcoin There's different ways to look online and find out if companies accept Bitcoin as a form of payment I always like talking about Bitcoin roll out one for that I'm sorry I pick up a lot of people But anyways there's a directory currently when you use the air bits app that brings up that Bitcoin Companies out there, and then we'll have that to app Bitcoin network if you go to www.bit.life that's bit.life, that's, if you're a business owner, you decided to accept bitcoin you can actually list your company on there so bit.life is the website right there and then that will all tie together into our merchant processing about with the companies that we bring on onboard right there. So we're going to see an explosion moving into 2016 with more and more and more and more companies come onboard that accept Bitcoin. Cool, you get discounts too, right? Yeah. Your Starbucks 20% off. You saved 20% off of Starbucks and most people don't know that. Its all about public awareness and evolving the Bitcoin ecosystem. But we also noticed that you saved 20% off of at Target that's really big yeah that would've known and then also up to 20% off at Amazon.com so that's pretty good rate down there okay I think you covered it buddy. Thank you It's good to have you out of California you know with us a guard of the team also it's been worth it man it's been a mind opening trip and you've been working with me for two days now up here a little bit and stuff and just that what we're doing to build your business and get in the ground floor and there so we have more Bitcoin warriors all across the nation so well appreciate anything that you do all right guys well hey thank you for uh tuning in and watching this and uh subscribe to my YouTube channel below for more Bitcoin videos. all right thank you take care bye bye
